name: blender
description: Blender 3D — scene/file introspection, bpy docs, screenshots, renders (official Blender Lab MCP) plus asset import and AI 3D generation (ahujasid MCP for Blender).

prerequisites.name: npx
prerequisites.install_hint: Install Node.js from https://nodejs.org/ (npx is bundled with npm)
prerequisites.note: Needed for MCPorter to call the Blender MCP tools

prerequisites.name: uvx
prerequisites.note: Needed to run both Blender MCP servers

post_install.name: blender-mcp-official-addon
post_install.description: Official Blender Lab 'MCP' extension (Blender 5.1+). In Blender: Preferences > Get Extensions > add repository https://lab.blender.org/ > install 'MCP' > enable. Listens on 9876 (auto-start).

post_install.name: blender-mcp-legacy-addon
post_install.description: ahujasid 'MCP for Blender' add-on for Poly Haven / Sketchfab / Poly Pizza / Hyper3D / Hunyuan3D. Enable 'Interface: MCP for Blender', set its port to 9878 in the N-panel, click Start MCP Server.

post_install.name: mcporter
post_install.description: MCPorter CLI for calling MCP tools from the command line

integration_test.command: npx mcporter call blender.get_objects_summary && npx mcporter call blender-assets.get_addon_status user_prompt:"test"
integration_test.description: Blender must be running with the official MCP extension started on 9876 and the legacy MCP for Blender add-on started on 9878
